axes.base: near-black blue ground, a soft lift behind the subject
axes.line: thin exact edges on every facet; no hand wobble
axes.tone: flat facets in four blue steps, lit by one light, fogged with distance
axes.planB: polygon space: low-poly solids and tunnels with filled faces (faces3d)
axes.motion: facets part, turn and reassemble on the beat; the camera flies at 24 fps
axes.accent: flare red on one facet or one solid
axes.match: a shape made of shards becomes a solid of the same outline; cuts shatter
axes.overlays: none: the facets are the picture
